title: transcribe_audio arguments
description: Transcribe spoken audio or video speech into text, timed segments, word timestamps, speaker-diarized dialogue, or SRT/VTT subtitles. Use when the user asks for a transcript, verbatim spoken words, speaker labels, timecodes, or downloadable SRT/VTT captions from an uploaded or generated audio/video clip. To burn subtitles directly onto video frames, use add_subtitles instead (or chain transcribe_audio into add_subtitles).

model.description: Speech-to-text engine. "parakeet" (default): Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 — fast 25-language European transcription up to 2 hours with sentence and word timestamps. "nemotron": NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B — 40-language multilingual transcription up to 1 hour with speaker diarization (S01, S02, ...), custom vocabulary hotwords, and optional context prompt. When diarize=true, hotwords, or prompt is supplied and model is omitted, executors auto-select "nemotron".

audioSourceIndex.description: Which audio or video clip to transcribe. Negative indices address uploads (-1 = first uploaded audio/video clip, -2 = second upload) and 0-based non-negative indices address audio generated earlier in this conversation. Omit to default to -1 (most recent relevant upload or generated clip).

audio_source_url.description: REST alternative to audioSourceIndex: retrievable HTTPS media URL or inline base64 audio data URI.

timestamps.description: Timestamp granularity for transcript segments: "sentence" (default, phrase/sentence cues), "word" (word-level start/end timings in addition to segments), or "none" (plain text without timestamps).

diarize.description: Assign speaker labels (S01, S02, ...) across turns of dialogue. Supported by model="nemotron"; when diarize=true and model is omitted, executors auto-select "nemotron".

hotwords.description: Comma-separated custom vocabulary terms, proper nouns, brand names, or acronyms to bias recognition on model="nemotron". Limit 1000 characters.

prompt.description: Optional transcription context, topic summary, or language hint for model="nemotron". Limit 2000 characters.

responseFormat.description: Primary transcript representation to return: "json" (default structured transcript with segments/words), "text" (clean plain text), "srt" (SubRip subtitle document), or "vtt" (WebVTT subtitle document).
